district Rajouri for alleged commission of offences under Sections 420/467/468 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in which the petitioner has been named as an accused.

sentences.text: 3. The petitioner came forward with the present petition instituted on 24.11.2023 and uptill that time also, the investigation with respect to the aforesaid FIR had not seen its conclusion/closure.

The registration of the FIR in question proceeded upon a reference from the Inspector General of Police, Crime, J&K Jammu forwarding a complaint to the District Police Headquarter, Rajouri which, in turn, forwarded the same vide No. ct- sec/58/2019/1537/DPO dated 15.01.2020 to the SHO, Police Station, Darhal for lodging of an FIR against the petitioner and Mohd. Sajjad S/o Mohd. Afsar alleged that the petitioner managed allotment of a fair price shop licence (Dealership) by use of a fake documentary proof in the context of his educational qualification being matriculate when the petitioner is alleged to be non-matriculate and also with respect to his date of birth.
4. The petitioner came to be issued Fair Price Shop (FPS) licence for location 'Hill Tak' vide a Govt.
Order No. 286-FCS & CA of 2017 dated 06.07.2017 on the basis of which he came to run the said Fair Price Shop (FPS) for the given locality.

5. The registration of the aforesaid FIR had resulted in stoppaging of the supply of ration to the petitioner's said Fair Price Depot till the outcome of the investigation and in the meantime directing the consumers of the petitioner's Fair Price Depot to get ration from the Fair Price Depot run by one Mehtab Ahmed dealer of Bari Darhal.

6. Feeling aggrieved of the registration of the said FIR No. 0006/2020 dated 24.01.2020 read with stoppage of ration supply to his depot by the Tehsil Supply Officer (TSO), Darhal, the petitioner had approached this Court with a writ petition-WP(C) No. 831/2020 for seeking quashment of the aforesaid FIR and revocation of suspension of his Fair Price Depot licence.
The said writ petition of the petitioner came to be disposed of by this Court vide an order dated 14.09.2021 directing the conclusion of the investigation of the aforesaid FIR at the earliest.

7. Post the order dated 14.09.2021 passed in the said petition- WP(C) No. 831/2020, the Tehsil Supply Officer (TSO), Darhal addressed a communication No.
252/TSO/FCS&CA/DRL dated 12.10.2021 to the Secretary, J&K Board of School Education, Jammu for the purpose of seeking verification with respect to date of birth of the petitioner in response whereto the Joint Secretary, J&K Board of School Education, Jammu came forward with a letter No.
F(Veri-B) JD/2020/2065 dated 27.02.2022 thereby confirming the fact with respect to the petitioner's particulars in terms of his date of birth recorded to be 07.04.1984.
8.

sentences.text:
In the face of this clarification coming from the J&K Board of School Education, Jammu with respect to correct date of birth of the petitioner thereby ruling out any tampering at the end of the Mohd. Afsar Age 39 Years S/O Abdul Rashid ... vs Ut Of Jammu And Kashmir Through on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164241416/
2 petitioner with respect to his date of birth which, in the FIR, was alleged to be 03.02.1969, the Investigating Officer of the FIR No. 0006 of 2020 of Police Station, Darhal ought to have brought the matter to a closure but it seems that the aforesaid FIR, with malafide intent, has been allowed to continue without any closure and without any explanation from the end of the respondents thereby rendering the FIR nothing but a sheer abuse of the process of law aiming to subject the petitioner to an unwarranted harassment and, therefore, the petitioner is well within his right to urge that the FIR deserves to be quashed by this Court.

entities.label: ORG

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
9. The very fact that even after the intervention of this court in a writ petition-WP(C) No. 831/2020 whereby this Court came to direct in terms of an order dated 14.09.2021 the conclusion of the investigation of the FIR in question at an earliest, this Court is at loss to figure as to on what basis the said FIR has remained pending investigation w.e.f., 14.09.2021 till filing of the present writ petition on 24.11.2023 without bothering the SHO of the Police Station, Darhal and the Sr.
Superintendent of Police, Rajouri to seek an accountability from the delinquent investigation officer.
There is a reason to doubt that the pendency of the FIR is with an aim to keep on extending the suspension of the petitioner's fair price depot licence to the benefit of a third person who has been assigned the consumers of the petitioner's fair price depot.
10.
Accordingly, the present petition is allowed and the impugned FIR No. 0006/2020 dated 24.01.2020 is quashed.

A copy of this order be forwarded to the SHO, Police Station, Darhal for closing the FIR in question as being quashed and to the Sr. Superintendent of Police, Rajouri to enquire with respect to the delinquency of the Investigation Officer in the case and fix the accountability.
Whether the order is speaking: Yes  Whether the order is reportable: No Mohd.
